name: Rene J. Trevino
office: City of Artesia, Member of the City Council

items.text: Rene J. Trevino is a member of the Artesia City Council and serves as its mayor. He has served on the council since 2018. He says he has operated his own company for 26 years and his Artesia-based business employs 22 people. He calls public safety his top priority and says crime has gone down each year. He also says he has strengthened transparency and financial accountability at City Hall. In February 2026, he moved to buy a $307,511 restroom building kit for Artesia Park; the council approved it 3-0.
